coverage: A term family appears in at least two distinct transcript segments per talk. Categories overlap. The network also requires both concepts to meet this talk-level coverage rule.
network: Undirected positive normalized pointwise mutual information, disjoint ~150-word windows; >=8 co-windows and >=4 talks; display cutoff .08. Co-occurrence is not causation, sequence, or agreement.
scope: Clip boundaries can retain brief introductions within talks. The two captured main-stage feeds and recorded inserts; not the full multi-room event. Master ASR text, not written summaries or speaker bios. Names and numerical claims can contain transcription errors.
claim_labels: Eight excerpts reviewed in transcript context. Labels describe the excerpt, not the whole talk. Speaker results are not independently verified.
